title: Fix checked line background color making text unreadable
description: When a line is checked/learned, the bright green background is almost white and makes the Farsi/main language text unreadable. Need to use a more subtle color that maintains readability.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Checked/learned lines use a subtle green that doesn't overpower text
Farsi text remains clearly readable on learned line background
Visual distinction between learned/not-learned is still clear
